t: Where patience has to happen for it to count
a: ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنْ صَبَرْتَ وَاحْتَسَبْتَ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأُولَى لَمْ أَرْضَ لَكَ ثَوَابًا دُونَ الْجَنَّةِ
p: Ibna Ādam, in ṣabarta wa-ḥtasabta ʿinda-ṣ-ṣadmati-l-ūlā, lam arḍa laka thawāban dūna-l-jannah
m: Son of Adam, if you are patient and seek the reward at the first blow, I will not be satisfied with any reward for you short of the Garden.
